BURSEVI:v6p220/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p220/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p220/r7.claim: They should fear God and obey Shuayb because his command comes from God, so obeying him is obedience to God in reality.
BURSEVI:v6p220/r7.anchor: فإن أمري أمر عن الله وإطاعتي إطاعة الله في الحقيقة

MUQATIL:26:176-180/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:176-180/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:176-180/r2.claim: Shuaib asks whether they fear God, declares himself a trustworthy messenger, urges obedience, and says he asks no payment for belief: his reward rests only with the Lord of the worlds.
MUQATIL:26:176-180/r2.anchor: ولم يكن شعيب من نسبهم، فلذلك لم يقل عز وجل أخوهم شعيب،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r3.speaker: المفسرون
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r3.claim: The repeated formula in this sūra shows that all prophets made one shared call: piety, obedience, exclusive worship, and asking no payment for preaching.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r3.anchor: دعوتهم كانت (¬3) على وجه # واحد] (¬1) وأنهم كانوا متفقين على الأمر بالتقوى والطاعة والإخلاص في العبادة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r4.claim: The common prophetic message also included refraining from taking payment for the call and delivery of the message.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p117#2/r4.anchor: والامتناع من أخذ الأجر على الدعوى وتبليغ الرسالة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r4.claim: The opening verses repeat material from the preceding prophetic account and have already been explained.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r4.anchor: These verses occur in the previous anecdote and have already been explained.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r8.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r8.claim: The prophets' calls share a form because they agree on piety, obedience, sincere worship, and refusing payment for preaching and conveying the message.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r8.anchor: وإنما كانت دعوة هؤلاء الأنبياء كلهم فيما حكى الله عنهم على صيغة واحدة

BIQAI-FULL:v5p385/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p385/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p385/r10.claim: He calls them to fear God and obey him because his sincerity is established, and because God has favored them with the grove and other gifts.

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r3.claim: The author says Shuaib's reported commands and prohibitions are more numerous than Salih's, as their quoted speeches show.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r3#6/r3.anchor: ما ذكره شعيب من الأوامر والنواهي

NASHR:v2p336/r10.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p336/r10.speaker: يعقوب
NASHR:v2p336/r10.claim: Yaqub affirms the sixteen listed extra yāʾs in both connected and pause forms: the eight quoted forms plus أطيعون in eight places.
NASHR:v2p336/r10.anchor: أثبت الياء في جميعها يعقوب في الحالين

QIRAAT-ER:26:179:5#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:179:5#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:26:179:5#1/r1.claim: The final yāʾ restores the fuller pronoun and, in the Aykah context, underscores Shuʿayb’s personal authority: obey me.
QIRAAT-ER:26:179:5#1/r1.anchor: in the Aykah context, the fuller form intensifies the personal specificity of the messenger's authority claim

ALUSI-FULL:v19p118/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118/r1.claim: The call to fear God and obey follows the same recurring prophetic pattern explained above, with the wage disclaimer and the command to give full measure following it.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118/r1.anchor: وما أسألكم عليه من أجر إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين

DURR-FULL:v6p318/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p318/r1.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v6p318/r1.claim: The people of al-Aykah followed the polytheistic pattern of Madyan; Shuʿayb identified himself as their trustworthy messenger and called them to fear and obey God.
DURR-FULL:v6p318/r1.anchor: أصحاب الأيكة مع ما كانوا فيه من الشرك استنوا سنة أصحاب مدين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p185/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p185/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p185/r1.claim: The command to fear the Creator reinforces the opening command but adds creation of them and earlier peoples as proof that God deserves fear; the conjunction signals this added basis.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p185/r1.anchor: وزاد فيه دليل استحقاقه التقوى بأن الله خلقهم وخلق الأمم من قبلهم
